remarks:
Move in Ready! Located in the Marrano's Mission Hills patio home community in Hamburg. Easy living lifestyle with an HOA that provides snow removal and lawn care. Situated on a lot that has no rear neighbors and no neighbor on the one side. 9 ft ceilings throughout the first floor. Primary bedroom located on the first floor with WIC and primary bath with double sinks and ceramic tile shower. 2nd first floor bedroom and main bath. 3rd bedroom or office upstairs. Large breakfast bar for entertaining in the kitchen along with a ceramic tile backsplash and quartz countertops, SS dishwasher and built in microwave. The kitchen is open to the dinette and living room w/ cozy fireplace. Luxury vinyl plank floors throughout most of the home. First floor laundry. Beautiful lighting and plumbing fixtures! Landscaping and sprinkler system included. For more info please stop by our model home at 4543 Camp Rd #208 1-5 pm daily (closed Thursday & Friday). 
See also ML#B1696339.
facts: Breakfast Area, Entrance Foyer, Eat In Kitchen, Kitchen Family Room Combo, Quartz Counters, Sliding Glass Doors, Bedroom On Main Level
